title.es: Una Battle Skill para dos Combos
title.en: One Battle Skill for two Combos

body.es: El Combo de Arcane aplica Imprisonment. En forma INT, su Battle Skill sobre un enemigo con Imprisonment devuelve SP, lo termina antes y hace Explosion DMG. El autor muestra que, con dos Combos puestos, una sola Battle Skill detona los dos y devuelve el SP dos veces: 60 con Arcane a potencial 0 y 80 a potencial 1. El kit lo cuadra: 30 SP por Combo, más 10 a potencial 1. El autor dice que en ese punto Arcane se refresca para el segundo Combo; en el kit, lo que baja ese cooldown es la Ultimate de Si, que afecta a quien va en Posición 01, aquí Arcane.
body.en: Arcane's Combo applies Imprisonment. In INT form, her Battle Skill on an enemy with Imprisonment returns SP, ends it early and deals Explosion DMG. The author shows that, with two Combos up, one Battle Skill detonates both and returns SP twice: 60 with Arcane at potential 0 and 80 at potential 1. The kit matches: 30 SP per Combo, plus 10 at potential 1. The author says Arcane refreshes at that point for the second Combo; in the kit, what lowers that cooldown is Si's Ultimate, which affects whoever is in Position 01, here Arcane.

body.es: Según el autor, el burst principal no depende del Ultimate de Arcane. Sale de tres cosas después de lanzarlo: la Battle Skill de Arcane que detona los dos Combos, la Battle Skill y la Ultimate de Tangtang con tres Waterspouts bajo el Amp de las dos Ultimates, y el Combo de Si con cuatro Cryo, también con ese doble Amp. Las dos Ultimates son la de Xaihi, que da Cryo Amp y Nature Amp, y la de Si, que da Cryo Amp y Heat Amp.
body.en: Per the author, the main burst does not depend on Arcane's Ultimate. It comes from three things after casting it: Arcane's Battle Skill detonating both Combos, Tangtang's Battle Skill and Ultimate with three Waterspouts under the Amp of both Ultimates, and Si's Combo with four Cryo, also under that double Amp. The two Ultimates are Xaihi's, which grants Cryo Amp and Nature Amp, and Si's, which grants Cryo Amp and Heat Amp.

body.es: La Battle Skill de Xaihi y el Ultimate de Arcane piden dos Final Strikes cada uno: el Combo de Xaihi sale al gastar las dos curaciones de su cristal, y la segunda parte de la Ultimate de Arcane se abre tras dos Cluster Strikes. Lanzarlos juntos hace que las mismas dos Final Strikes sirvan para ambos.
body.en: Xaihi's Battle Skill and Arcane's Ultimate each ask for two Final Strikes: Xaihi's Combo fires when her crystal spends its two heals, and the second part of Arcane's Ultimate opens after two Cluster Strikes. Casting them together makes the same two Final Strikes count for both.

body.es: El autor se adelanta a una objeción: el ciclo mide 63 s porque en su demo hay un Finisher. Responde que en 60 s es difícil que el jefe no entre en Stagger. Además, sin contar los 100 SP de ese Finisher, sigue habiendo más de 100 SP al llegar a la Battle Skill de Tangtang, gracias al SP que ella devuelve y a la Final Strike extra que cabe en el tiempo que no gastas en el Finisher.
body.en: The author heads off an objection: the cycle runs 63 s because the demo has a Finisher. The answer is that over 60 s it is hard for the boss not to enter Stagger. Also, without counting that Finisher's 100 SP, there are still over 100 SP by the time of Tangtang's Battle Skill, thanks to the SP she returns and the extra Final Strike that fits in the time not spent on the Finisher.

name.es: Maygi - INT con Kay · Xaihi · Tangtang
name.en: Maygi - INT with Kay · Xaihi · Tangtang

blurb.es: El último equipo de la guía de Kay: Arcane en forma INT con Xaihi y Tangtang. Las dos activaciones de la Battle Skill de Xaihi se reparten entre Arcane y Tangtang mientras suben las acumulaciones, y el final junta los Ultimates de Xaihi, Arcane y Tangtang. Según la guía, su daño deja algo que desear frente a otras opciones de soporte de Arcane INT, pero sigue siendo bastante potente.
blurb.en: The last team of the Kay guide: INT-form Arcane with Xaihi and Tangtang. The two procs of Xaihi's Battle Skill are shared between Arcane and Tangtang while the stacks go up, and the ending brings together Xaihi's, Arcane's and Tangtang's Ultimates. Per the guide, its damage leaves a bit to be desired next to some of INT Arcane's other support options, but it is still decently powerful.

whatItDoes.es: Arcane en forma INT es la carry y Tangtang, la segunda fuente de daño. Cada Battle Skill de Xaihi da dos activaciones que se reparten entre las dos. Con 2 acumulaciones sale el Combo de Arcane y con 3 el de Tangtang. Al final se deja listo el Combo de Arcane y se encadenan los Ultimates.
whatItDoes.en: INT-form Arcane is the carry and Tangtang is the second source of damage. Each Xaihi Battle Skill gives two procs that are shared between them. At 2 stacks Arcane's Combo procs, and at 3 Tangtang's does. At the end you prep Arcane's Combo and chain the Ultimates.

do.en: Xaihi's Battle Skill, one proc on Arcane and one on Tangtang, and Xaihi's and Tangtang's Combos.

overview.es: Arcane lleva una build INT bastante típica y Tangtang necesita algo de Ultimate Gain, así que va con Bonekrusha Heavy Armor. La guía pide evitar Stanza of Memorials en Xaihi, porque el daño de Tangtang no es despreciable y conviene que reciba buffs. La rotación reparte las dos activaciones de la Battle Skill de Xaihi entre Arcane y Tangtang. La guía cierra diciendo que el daño total deja algo que desear frente a otras opciones de soporte de Arcane INT, pero que sigue siendo bastante potente.
overview.en: Arcane runs a fairly typical INT build and Tangtang needs a little Ultimate Gain, so she goes on Bonekrusha Heavy Armor. The guide asks you to avoid Stanza of Memorials on Xaihi, because Tangtang's damage is not negligible and you want her to be buffed. The rotation shares the two procs of Xaihi's Battle Skill between Arcane and Tangtang. The guide closes by saying that the overall damage leaves a bit to be desired next to some of INT Arcane's other support options, but that it is still decently powerful.

pros.es: Tangtang hace un daño que no es despreciable como segunda fuente.
pros.en: Tangtang deals non-negligible damage as the second source.

pros.es: El equipo de Arcane es bastante típico de la forma INT.
pros.en: Arcane's gear is fairly typical for the INT form.

cons.es: El daño total deja algo que desear frente a otras opciones de soporte de Arcane INT, según la guía.
cons.en: The overall damage leaves a bit to be desired next to some of INT Arcane's other support options, per the guide.

cons.es: Hay que repartir las activaciones de Xaihi entre dos operadoras y cortar un combo de básicos a tiempo.
cons.en: You have to share Xaihi's procs between two operators and cut a basic attack combo at the right time.

body.es: Cada Battle Skill de Xaihi da dos activaciones, y la guía las reparte entre Arcane y Tangtang en lugar de darlas a una sola. Después de las dos van los Combos de la ronda.
body.en: Each Xaihi Battle Skill gives two procs, and the guide shares them between Arcane and Tangtang instead of giving both to one. After both come that round's Combos.

title.en: What procs at each stack count

body.es: La primera ronda da los Combos de Xaihi y de Tangtang. Con 2 acumulaciones salen los de Arcane y Kay, y con 3, otra vez el de Tangtang. Antes del burst se vuelve a 2 para que el Combo de Arcane esté listo.
body.en: The first round gives Xaihi's and Tangtang's Combos. At 2 stacks Arcane's and Kay's proc, and at 3, Tangtang's again. Before the burst you go back to 2 so that Arcane's Combo is ready.

body.es: El Combo de Kay sale al aplicar Nature Infliction o al dispararse cualquier Arts Burst, siempre que le quede al menos una Weapon, y recupera SP para el equipo. Su Ultimate no se usa.
body.en: Kay's Combo triggers when Nature Infliction is applied or any Arts Burst goes off, as long as she has at least one Weapon left, and it recovers SP for the team. Her Ultimate is not used.

action.es: [Battle Skill de Xaihi → dos combos de básicos] ×3, con los Combos de Xaihi y Tangtang; de Xaihi, Arcane y Kay; y de Xaihi, Tangtang y Kay.
action.en: [Xaihi's Battle Skill → two basic attack combos] ×3, with Xaihi's and Tangtang's Combos; Xaihi's, Arcane's and Kay's; and Xaihi's, Tangtang's and Kay's.

do.es: Battle Skill de Xaihi. Reparte las dos activaciones entre Arcane y Tangtang y usa los Combos de Xaihi y de Tangtang.
do.en: Xaihi's Battle Skill. Share the two procs between Arcane and Tangtang and use Xaihi's and Tangtang's Combos.

do.es: Repite hasta 2 acumulaciones: salen los Combos de Xaihi, de Arcane y de Kay.
do.en: Repeat, getting to 2 stacks: Xaihi's, Arcane's and Kay's Combos proc.

do.es: No pares ahí: repite hasta 3 acumulaciones y salen los Combos de Xaihi, de Tangtang y de Kay.
do.en: Don't stop there: repeat, getting to 3 stacks, and Xaihi's, Tangtang's and Kay's Combos proc.

phase.es: Battle Skills de Tangtang y de Arcane

action.en: Xaihi's Battle Skill → basic attack combo → Tangtang's Battle Skill → Arcane's Combo → Arcane's Battle Skill → Kay's Combo → basic attack combo → Xaihi's Combo.

do.en: Xaihi's Battle Skill again.

do.en: Before you finish the second basic attack combo, use Tangtang's Battle Skill, along with Arcane's Combo and Battle Skill, as well as Kay's Combo.

do.es: Termina el segundo combo de básicos y usa el Combo de Xaihi.
do.en: Finish the second basic attack combo and use Xaihi's Combo.

action.es: Última Battle Skill de Xaihi → dos combos de básicos → Combos de Xaihi y Kay.
action.en: Last Xaihi Battle Skill → two basic attack combos → Xaihi's and Kay's Combos.

do.es: Battle Skill de Xaihi por última vez: hacen falta 2 acumulaciones para que el Combo de Arcane vuelva a salir en el burst. Combos de Xaihi y de Kay.
do.en: Xaihi's Battle Skill one last time: you need to get to 2 stacks to proc Arcane's Combo again for the burst. Xaihi's and Kay's Combos.

action.es: Ultimate de Xaihi → Combo de Arcane → Ultimate de Arcane → Combos de Tangtang y Kay → Ultimate de Tangtang → Dive Attack → Battle Skill de Arcane → Finisher → Battle Skill de Kay → Combos de Kay y Arcane → combo de básicos → Ultimate de Arcane (parte 2) → Battle Skill de Arcane.
action.en: Xaihi's Ultimate → Arcane's Combo → Arcane's Ultimate → Tangtang's and Kay's Combos → Tangtang's Ultimate → Dive Attack → Arcane's Battle Skill → Finisher → Kay's Battle Skill → Kay's and Arcane's Combos → basic attack combo → Arcane's Ultimate (part 2) → Arcane's Battle Skill.

do.es: En cuanto entre el Combo de Xaihi, su Ultimate.
do.en: After landing Xaihi's Combo, her Ultimate.

do.en: Arcane's Combo and Ultimate.

do.en: Dive Attack on Arcane, her Battle Skill and the Finisher, along with Kay's Battle Skill.

do.es: Combos de Kay y de Arcane, un combo de básicos, la parte 2 del Ultimate de Arcane y otra Battle Skill.
do.en: Kay's and Arcane's Combos, a basic attack combo, part 2 of Arcane's Ultimate and another Battle Skill.

tip.es: Con algo más de paciencia puedes usar también los Combos de Tangtang y de Kay y cancelar su pausa con el Ultimate de Arcane. En la toma de la guía salen después.
tip.en: If you're a little more patient, you can also hit Tangtang's and Kay's Combos and cancel their timestop with Arcane's Ultimate. In the guide's footage they come after it.

pitfalls.es: Poner Stanza of Memorials en Xaihi: el daño de Tangtang no es despreciable y conviene que reciba buffs.
pitfalls.en: Putting Stanza of Memorials on Xaihi: Tangtang's damage is not negligible and you want her to be buffed.

pitfalls.es: Dar las dos activaciones de Xaihi a la misma operadora: la guía las reparte entre Arcane y Tangtang.
pitfalls.en: Giving both Xaihi procs to the same operator: the guide shares them between Arcane and Tangtang.

pitfalls.es: Entrar al burst sin las 2 acumulaciones: sin ellas no sale el Combo de Arcane.
pitfalls.en: Entering the burst without the 2 stacks: without them Arcane's Combo doesn't proc.
